title: Miscreant Society
description: Miscreant Society is a lightweight modpack for my family’s SMP server, centered around Create, Chipped, Farmer’s Delight, Paladin’s Furniture, and a few others. Updates occur only when absolutely necessary, most client-side mods disabled by default.
body: Miscreant Society is a modpack created for my family’s SMP server. It’s a lightweight pack centered around the mods Create, Chipped, Farmer’s Delight, Paladin’s Furniture, and a few others. For players who prefer not to frequently update modpacks, Miscreant Society will only receive updates when absolutely necessary. Most client-side mods are disabled by default but can be enabled through the launcher settings.
